rows.notes: The study is explicitly labelled a Review Article and only summarises other work on IoT/WSN flood monitoring and SAR flood mapping; it reports no data, experiment, survey or validated model of its own (it proposes a conceptual FMEWS framework in Section 4.3 without implementation). It is not about UAVs in agriculture: UAVs appear only in a one-paragraph summary of Munawar et al. [19] on CNN flood detection from UAV images, and nothing concerns farmers, agriculture, drought adaptation or early warning delivered to farmers. The passage's claim (UAVs helping farmers adapt to droughts and floods via monitoring and early warning) is therefore not supported by any own result of this study.

notes: Full text appears complete (10 pages, through references). Study is a narrative review with a proposed but untested framework; no primary data.
